ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupying the distal 30-40% of both lobes; heavy dark pigmentation dominates the central and medial regions; high-contrast dark vertical mottling and streaks penetrate the distal white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity at the distal tips transitioning into a concave curvature that terminates at the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters (likely barnacle scars) scattered across the distal high-intensity white regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Clear sets of parallel, high-contrast dark linear marks (rake marks) crossing the white-pigmented areas on the distal sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks and several deep irregular serrations on the trailing edge that deviate from standard symmetrical scalloping.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel clusters representing water spray and droplets occluding the proximal-central region where the fluke meets the peduncle.
